title: Thinking on designing for the End
summary: Kahran and Divya open Season 2 by arguing that products, relationships and personal projects all benefit from being designed with an end date in mind. They trade examples — games as service vs games as finite works, marriage vow renewals every five years, Duolingo without a stopping point, learning surfing — and explore why clients and partners often resist the conversation about endings.
topics: games as service vs finite games

intents.display: to think about designing products and projects with an end date in mind
